signals.title: California’s coastal communities on alert as biggest waves in years hit state
signals.summary: Hazard warnings issued throughout week after powerful swells and waves of more than 9 metres recorded Multiple coastal hazard warnings were issued this week across California as successive areas of low pressure generated powerful swells and large breaking waves for coastal communities. Beaches and piers were closed last weekend as large waves crashed into California’s coastline. Offshore National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration buoys recorded wave heights of greater than 30ft (9 metres) last Friday. The Monterey, California, buoy recorded a wave height of 34.1ft, which would make it the highest reading in 30 years. Coastal warnings extended from last weekend through this week, with alerts extending until Friday night. Waves of 10-18ft are expected, with local sets of 18-22ft for San Luis Obispo county beaches and Santa Barbara county central coast beaches. These Pacific storm systems are also bringing unsettled conditions across the western US, with heavy rain, mountain snow, and strong winds through the coming days. signals.title: Show HN: Musset, open-source Scrivener alternative with an AI that never writes
signals.summary: I’m writing my first novel and could not find an app that fit my workflow: quiet like iA Writer, organized like Scrivener, and with AI so I can discuss my book while I write it. It allows me to feel less “alone” and have a sounding board while I write. - A book is a folder of plain Markdown files. Musset commits to a git repo, tracks versions and drafts without you having to know git. - Revisions are CriticMarkup inside the text. It manages docx revisions too, so your editor can edit a Word doc and you import their comments. - PDFs are typeset using Typst, embedded in the app, following each language’s typographic rules. - Spelling and grammar are checked using LanguageTool, also embedded. - Mac/Word, WordStar, vi and Emacs keyboard modes. The AI is optional and uses your Codex or Claude Code CLI. It comments, leaves margin notes, and checks continuity and your chapters against your style rules. It’s GPL-3.0 and free during the beta. When or if it reaches 1.0, if there is sufficient interest, the idea is to make it a small one-time payment ($9.90). signals.title: Temporal Extrapolation of Elastic Seismic Wave Propagation in Layered Media Using Neural Operators
signals.summary: arXiv:2611.25130v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Temporal prediction of seismic velocity fields beyond the time interval represented in training remains challenging for neural operator models. This study develops a coupled neural operator framework for stress-conditioned temporal prediction in layered elastic media. A time-integrator-embedded Deep Operator Network (TI-DeepONet) advances the velocity field through an embedded fourth-order Runge-Kutta (RK4) scheme, while a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) learns a residual correction to the predicted spatial field. The two components are trained jointly in a predictor-corrector configuration. Prediction is initialized with reference velocity fields at the first two time levels and proceeds autoregressively, with reference stress fields and prescribed excitation supplied throughout rollout, including beyond the training interval. Four cases consider horizontally polarized shear (SH) waves in four-layer soil columns with fixed total depths of 50 and 280 m, excited by third-order Gaussian-derivative (DOG3) wavelets with central frequencies between 0.5 and 6 Hz. signals.title: A Model of Diverse Sampling from Language Models
signals.summary: arXiv:2611.25003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models often produce high-quality individual samples but poor sets, with repeated samples clustering around the same semantic modes. We formalize diverse generation as sampling a size-$K$ subset of complete strings from a determinantal point process (DPP), where the likelihood encodes item quality, and the embedding geometry encodes repulsion between similar outputs. Exact inference over all strings is intractable, so we propose PoolDPP: draw a finite candidate pool from a tractable proposal, importance-weight the candidates toward the target quality, and run a $K$-DPP sampler on the induced pool kernel; a greedy MAP variant provides deterministic selection. We prove a finite-sample bound with an explicit constant: the KL divergence between the sampler's output and the target $K$-DPP decays as O(1/N) in the pool size. Empirically, PoolDPP extends the quality--diversity frontier on open-ended generation and the precision--recall frontier on ambiguous text-to-SQL (Ambrosia), and on mathematical reasoning (GSM8K), it raises diversity at about the same pass@$K$.

themes.reading: Chỉ đáng nâng thành tín hiệu khi có văn bản hoặc số liệu gốc, phạm vi áp dụng và nhóm chịu tác động xác định được. Tin kinh doanh đơn lẻ chưa đủ để kết luận xu hướng kinh tế Việt Nam.

evidence.title: Hơn 162.000 tỷ đồng xây ba tuyến cao tốc
evidence.summary: Quốc hội thông qua chủ trương đầu tư ba tuyến cao tốc dài hơn 430 km, tổng vốn gần 162.400 tỷ đồng, kết nối các khu vực Tây Bắc, Trung Bộ và Tây Nguyên.

evidence.title: Tài xế Green SM tăng thu nhập dịp cuối năm
evidence.summary: Một số tài xế Green SM ghi nhận lượng khách tăng sau khi hãng tung ưu đãi giảm giá cước, có thêm nguồn thu nhờ chính sách miễn phí nền tảng và hỗ trợ sạc.

evidence.title: Thông qua Luật Đất đai sửa đổi, bổ sung quyền lợi người bị thu hồi đất
evidence.summary: Người bị thu hồi đất ở được hoán đổi đất trong cùng xã, hỗ trợ phục hồi sinh kế và hưởng thêm chính sách bồi thường, tái định cư, theo Luật Đất đai vừa được Quốc hội thông qua.
